_doc: Sensitivity-check aliases: other names under which the SAME legal entity as a MEIP group head appears on UK PSC filings. Each entry is added to that group's head names only in the alias run (09); the headline figures never use them. Criterion: same legal entity (rename, legal-name word order, local-language vs trading name, or a filing typo) — never a parent, subsidiary or affiliate.

aliases.evidence: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation renamed NTT, Inc. effective 1 July 2025 (NTT press release 9 May 2025)
Cigna Corporation renamed The Cigna Group in February 2023 (SEC 8-K); UK PSC filings still carry the old name in 2026

aliases.kind: short/trading name of the same company
aliases.evidence: Inditex is the contraction of Industria de Diseno Textil, S.A.
Misspelling ('Gallager') of the group head's name in a UK PSC filing
Full legal name of Munich Re; MEIP's label puts 'AG' last
